newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Intel shrs continue rise.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Intel shrs continue rise.

text.p: Shares of Intel Corp rose in Wednesday's after-hours activity 1-1/8 to 120, traders said.
The stock climbed during regular trading to close up 4-7/8 at 118-7/8 after hitting a new 52-week high of 119-3/8.
The company said it expected fourth-quarter revenues to be "significantly" higher than the $5.15 billion made in third-quarter sales.

The semiconductor heavyweight made its forecast one day after California voters defeated a ballot initiative that would have given investors the right to sue companies and executives in state court. Intel had suspended making forecasts because of the proposed law.

The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 86,300 shares compared with 603,300 shares on Tuesday. Session two volume was 475,861 shares compared with Tuesday's volume of 7,683,800 shares.
The American Stock Exchange said it saw no after-hours activity.
